description: Desktop workspace for SSH, Telnet, serial connections, SFTP, terminals, and network maps.
notes: This package extracts the official NSIS installer into the Scoop version directory. The installer itself is not executed, so its NSIS hooks are not run.

Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime must already be installed. The original installer includes a WebView2 installer and installs the runtime when missing; this Scoop extraction intentionally does not install system components. Install the Microsoft Evergreen WebView2 Runtime separately if Netrix does not start: https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/
The upstream v0.3.0-beta.8 release is unsigned. Windows may display an unknown-publisher warning.
The current upstream Windows release provides an x64 installer; this manifest does not advertise x86 or ARM64 builds.
